subject: Game Theory
title: AI in Negotiation
description: A quick win: understand AI in Negotiation.

hook.text: AI systems are now negotiating on behalf of humans—buying goods, settling claims, drafting contracts.

buildup.text: AI negotiators don't get emotional, tired, or anchored. They process offers at superhuman speed.

discovery.text: Facebook's AI bots learned to negotiate by playing against each other—even developing deceptive strategies.

twist.text: When two AI negotiators meet, they can find optimal solutions instantly—but they lack human judgment on fairness.

climax.text: The future: AI handles routine negotiations, freeing humans for the high-stakes deals requiring trust.

punchline.text: Machines handle the math. Humans handle the trust.

quiz.question: What weakness do AI negotiators have?
options: They lack human judgment on fairness
